description: EW AI Flowchart turns process documents into validated EFD 2.1 JSON. EW AI Flowchart 將流程文件轉換為可驗證的 EFD 2.1 JSON。

author.name: Embodied Worker / 具象職人股份有限公司

interface.shortDescription: Text to EFD｜文字生具象流程圖
interface.longDescription: EW AI Flowchart turns SOPs, meeting notes, job instructions, and process requirements into validated EFD 2.1 JSON for continued engineering work. Unlike an ordinary flowchart that mainly shows sequence, an embodied flow diagram also models business stages, organization responsibilities, node-level RACI, evidence, decisions, exception paths, stable references, and validation. EW AI Flowchart 將 SOP、會議紀要、工作說明與流程需求轉換為可持續編輯的 EFD 2.1 JSON。具象流程圖不只呈現一般流程圖的先後順序，也建立流程階段、組織責任、節點級 RACI、證據、判斷、例外路徑、穩定引用與工程驗證。
